title: Stop an agent's compaction from overwriting its spawner's handoff
why: A builder agent's compaction replaced its coordinator's handoff, digest and state in excel-ui-kit, so the coordinator lost its record.
source: owner chat 11:02 CST Nov 12 via retrospective (session_013NEJKz5AWFJhGvmCUoi6wQ) and coordinator 11:04 CST; plan docs/plans/agent-handoff-lock-report.md on branch agent-handoff-lock-report (5328b4e70)
note: Plan part 1. Root fix: the compaction hooks skip agent worktrees (a call that carries a valid agent_id). Plus a guard rule refusing an agent's write to the session's handoff, named a bandaid; it covers the shell-write form too, or files that form as a debt. Red test: an agent Write to the handoff is refused after the fix; the same Write with no agent_id is allowed on main and after. Lane handoff-agent-write started 11:03 CST Nov 12 (coordinator).
